scope: Read-only preservation comparison of archived 353-scenario evidence and the 377-scenario wave. No duel is rerun by this comparison.

method.reportDigests: SHA-256 of the exact report file bytes at the stated paths. These change when collector metadata or sourceHashes are refreshed.
method.scenarioDigests: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialized with sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False. Arrays keep their exact order; integers, strings, booleans, null and all values are preserved. Entire scenario digests include every scenario key.
method.comparisonUnit: Scenario id; duplicate IDs fail rather than overwrite the validation.
method.scopeLimit: This comparison does not certify that top-level sourceHashes are the final frozen source set or that all card branches/browser flows are covered.

reportDigestRefreshes.reason: Refresh after final collector dependency metadata gel. Scope still excludes certification of top-level sourceHashes.
